build_graph_propagation_forward: build a forward propagation through a JaxPR computational graph using GraphTransform and InputBound
build_graph_propagation_backward: build a backward propagation from intermediate nodes to target indices using BackwardGraphTransform
create_opwise_graph_transform: create an OpwiseGraphTransform that maps each Jax primitive to a bound propagation function
create_backward_opwise_transform: create a BackwardOpwiseTransform that maps each Jax primitive to a backward propagation function
create_updated_graph_transform: create an UpdatedGraphTransform that extends a base transform with overridden primitive transforms
